description: Re-tune an existing copy-trade subscription by id. Pause it (stop new copies, keep the follow), resume it, stop it, and/or change its sizing rule and guard rules (caps, daily budget, market-cap band, oracle/safety gates, performance fee). MONEY-ADJACENT: guard changes alter how much of your SOL future copies may spend — non-custodial, intents only. Only the fields you pass change; the rest are preserved. Editing guards on a paused subscription keeps it paused unless you also set status:"active". Idempotent. Returns the updated subscription. Requires THREE_WS_API_KEY.

copier_wallet.description: Change the Solana wallet that executes mirrored trades.

copy_sells.description: Whether to mirror the leader's exits as well as entries.

daily_budget_sol.description: Max SOL fanned out per UTC day (> 0).

id.description: UUID of the subscription to update (from list_subscriptions).

max_open_copies.description: Cap on concurrent pending copy intents (1–100).

mcap_ceiling_usd.description: Skip coins above this market cap (USD). Pass null to clear the ceiling.

mcap_floor_usd.description: Skip coins below this market cap (USD). Pass null to clear the floor.

min_oracle_score.description: Skip coins below this Oracle conviction score (0–100). Pass null to clear the gate.

min_order_sol.description: Skip dust copies below this, in SOL. Cannot exceed per_trade_cap_sol.

multiplier.description: Multiple of the leader's entry when sizing_rule="multiplier".

pct_balance.description: Percent of your SOL per copy when sizing_rule="pct_balance" (0–100).

per_trade_cap_sol.description: Hard ceiling on any single copy, in SOL (> 0).

perf_fee_bps.description: Leader's performance fee in basis points (0–3000).

require_safety_pass.description: Skip a copy when the coin's safety cannot be confirmed.

sizing_rule.description: Change the sizing rule: fixed | multiplier | pct_balance.

status.description: Set the lifecycle status: active (resume), paused (halt new copies, keep the follow), or stopped (end it, keeps history).

telegram_chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID for copy-intent alerts. Pass null to clear.

name: update_subscription
title: Update a copy-trade subscription
